task: Which of the following chemical compounds has the highest boiling point? A) Ethanol B) Dimethyl ether C) Propanol D) Acetone. Answer with the letter.
What is the remainder when 2^100 is divided by 13? A) 9 B) 3 C) 7 D) 11. Answer with the letter.

According to the Phillips curve, which scenario is most likely to occur when unemployment falls to 4% in an economy currently experiencing 2% inflation? A) Inflation rises to 3% B) Inflation rises to 5% C) Inflation remains at 2% D) Inflation falls to 1%. Answer with the letter.

Which amendment to the United States Constitution was ratified closest in time to the passage of the 19th Amendment granting women the right to vote? A) 15th Amendment B) 16th Amendment C) 17th Amendment D) 18th Amendment. Answer with the letter.
A block slides down a frictionless incline of angle 30° and length 10 m. What is its speed at the bottom? A) 5.0 m/s B) 7.7 m/s C) 8.9 m/s D) 10.0 m/s. Answer with the letter.
What is the sum of the interior angles of a regular pentagon? A) 540° B) 600° C) 720° D) 900°. Answer with the letter.

A convex quadrilateral has consecutive side lengths 5, 7, 5, and 7 units, and its opposite angles are equal. Which shape can it be? A) Rectangle B) Rhombus C) Kite D) Isosceles trapezoid. Answer with the letter.
In Big-O notation, which of the following functions grows the slowest as n \u2192 \u221e? A) n^0.5 B) log n C) n^(1/log n) D) \u221a(log n). Answer with the letter.
In Shakespeare's 'Macbeth', which of the following characters is the first to suspect Macbeth of regicide? A) Banquo B) Macduff C) Lady Macbeth D) Lennox. Answer with the letter.
Which change will increase the equilibrium concentration of NH3? A) Increase temperature B) Add a catalyst C) Decrease pressure D) Increase pressure by halving volume. Answer with the letter.
What is the sum of the first 10 prime numbers? A) 129 B) 130 C) 131 D) 132. Answer with the letter.
A block slides down a frictionless incline of 30° for 5 seconds starting from rest. What is its final speed? (g=9.8 m/s²) A) 23.5 m/s B) 25.0 m/s C) 23.9 m/s D) 24.5 m/s. Answer with the letter.
Which of the following compounds has the highest boiling point? A) CH3CH2OH (ethanol) B) CH3OCH3 (dimethyl ether) C) CH3CH(OH)CH3 (isopropanol) D) CH3CH2CH2OH (propanol). Answer with the letter.
In which year did the Treaty of Westphalia, ending the Thirty Years' War, get signed? A) 1618 B) 1648 C) 1652 D) 1660. Answer with the letter.
What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of size n? A) O(log n) B) O(n) C) O(n log n) D) O(1). Answer with the letter.

If the price elasticity of demand for a product is -1.2, what happens to total revenue when price increases? A) It increases B) It decreases C) It stays the same D) It first increases then decreases. Answer with the letter.
A regular hexagon is inscribed in a circle of radius 10. What is the length of one side of the hexagon? A) 10 B) 10√2 C) 10√3 D) 20. Answer with the letter.
Which blood type is known as the universal donor for plasma transfusions? A) O- B) O+ C) AB+ D) AB-. Answer with the letter.

A farmer has a fox, a chicken, and grain. He can only take one at a time across a river. If left alone, the fox will eat the chicken, and the chicken will eat the grain. What is the minimum number of trips required to get all three safely across? A) 5 B) 7 C) 6 D) 4. Answer with the letter.
A fair six-sided die is rolled twice. What is the probability that the sum of the two rolls is 7? A) 1/6 B) 1/12 C) 5/36 D) 1/9. Answer with the letter.
In a standard deck of 52 cards, what is the probability of drawing a heart or a queen in a single draw? Express as a reduced fraction. A) 4/13 B) 5/13 C) 7/26 D) 9/26. Answer with the letter.
A rectangular garden has perimeter 60 meters. If its area is maximized, which of the following could be the length of one side? A) 10 B) 15 C) 20 D) 30. Answer with the letter.
Which of the following oxides has the greatest molar mass? A) Fe2O3 B) Al2O3 C) SiO2 D) MgO. Answer with the letter.

Which list comprehension produces a list of squares of odd numbers from 1 to 9 inclusive? A) [x**2 for x in range(1,10) if x%2==0] B) [x**2 for x in range(1,10,2)] C) [x**2 for x in range(0,10,2)] D) [x**2 for x in range(2,11,2)]. Answer with the letter.

Which of the following battles occurred latest in the American Civil War? A) Battle of Gettysburg B) Battle of Antietam C) Battle of Appomattox Court House D) Battle of Fort Sumter. Answer with the letter.
What is the derivative of f(x) = x^x? A) x^x (ln x + 1) B) x^x (ln x) C) x^{x-1} (ln x + 1) D) x^{x} (1/ln x). Answer with the letter.
Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that the sum is either 7 or 11? A) 1/6 B) 5/36 C) 7/36 D) 2/9. Answer with the letter.
If a country's nominal GDP grows by 4% and its inflation rate is 2%, what is the approximate real GDP growth rate? A) 2% B) 4% C) 6% D) 8%. Answer with the letter.
Which star is closest to Earth after the Sun? A) Proxima Centauri B) Sirius C) Alpha Centauri A D) Barnard's Star. Answer with the letter.
An undirected simple graph has 6 vertices each of degree 3. How many edges does the graph have? A) 6 B) 8 C) 9 D) 12. Answer with the letter.
What is the sum of the interior angles of a convex pentagon? A) 540° B) 720° C) 360° D) 900°. Answer with the letter.
Which of the following compounds has the highest boiling point? A) CH3CH2OH (ethanol) B) CH3CH2CH2CH2OH (butanol) C) CH3CH2OCH3 (dimethyl ether) D) CH3OH (methanol). Answer with the letter.
In which year did the Battle of Hastings occur? A) 1215 B) 1415 C) 1066 D) 1492. Answer with the letter.
What is the final velocity of a 2 kg object dropped from rest from a height of 20 m (ignore air resistance)? A) 20.0 m/s B) 19.8 m/s C) 22.4 m/s D) 24.5 m/s. Answer with the letter.
Which novel starts with the line "It was the best of times, it was the worst of times"? A) Moby-Dick B) Pride and Prejudice C) A Tale of Two Cities D) Great Expectations. Answer with the letter.
If a country's GDP grows from $1.2 trillion to $1.5 trillion over one year, what is the approximate annual growth rate? A) 20% B) 25% C) 30% D) 35%. Answer with the letter.
Which enzyme synthesizes DNA during replication? A) RNA polymerase B) DNA ligase C) DNA helicase D) DNA polymerase. Answer with the letter.
Which river has the greatest discharge volume into the ocean? A) Amazon River B) Nile River C) Yangtze River D) Mississippi River. Answer with the letter.
What is the limit as x approaches 0 of (sin x)/x? A) 0 B) 1 C) Infinity D) Does not exist. Answer with the letter.
In Big-O notation, which algorithm has the best asymptotic time complexity for sorting n items? A) O(n^2) B) O(2^n) C) O(n log n) D) O(n^3). Answer with the letter.
What is the value of the limit lim_{x→0} (sin x - x cos x)/x^3? A) 0 B) 1/6 C) 1/3 D) 1/2. Answer with the letter.
Which compound has the highest boiling point? A) CH3Cl B) C2H6 C) C3H8 D) C4H10. Answer with the letter.
A block slides down a 20° frictional incline of length 2 m with μ=0.15. What is its speed at the bottom? A) 2.70 m/s B) 2.80 m/s C) 2.90 m/s D) 3.00 m/s. Answer with the letter.
In which year was the Treaty of Westphalia signed, ending the Thirty Years' War? A) 1618 B) 1648 C) 1650 D) 1665. Answer with the letter.
Which vitamin is fat‑soluble? A) Vitamin C B) Vitamin B12 C) Vitamin D D) Vitamin B6. Answer with the letter.
Which data structure provides O(1) amortized time for push and pop at both ends? A) Stack B) Queue C) Binary Heap D) Deque. Answer with the letter.

Which economic indicator directly measures the average price change of a basket of goods and services purchased by households? A) Producer Price Index B) Gross Domestic Product C) Consumer Price Index D) Unemployment Rate. Answer with the letter.
Which novel is credited with popularizing the stream‑of‑consciousness technique? A) Ulysses B) Mrs Dalloway C) The Sound and the Fury D) Heart of Darkness. Answer with the letter.
After Sirius, which star is the second brightest in the night sky? A) Canopus B) Arcturus C) Vega D) Capella. Answer with the letter.
Which country has the longest total coastline? A) Canada B) Indonesia C) Russia D) Australia. Answer with the letter.
